# Runaway

> Training on lithium-ion battery thermal runaway in data centers: warning signs, off-gas detection, emergency response, UPS battery safety and DC circuits, with a five-stage explorer.

Runaway (https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Li-ion Thermal Runaway Response, UPS & Battery System Safety, Batteries and DC Circuits, Universal Waste (spent batteries) training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Lithium-Ion Battery Thermal Runaway and Emergency Response Training](https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/courses/lithium-ion-thermal-runaway-emergency-response): $99.99 per seat, 4 Hours. Recognize and respond to lithium-ion battery thermal runaway before it escalates. Enroll: https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/courses/lithium-ion-thermal-runaway-emergency-response?buy=1021
- [Data Center UPS and Battery System Safety Training](https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-ups-battery-safety): $99.99 per seat, 2 Hours. Safety-focused training for anyone working around data center UPS and battery systems. Enroll: https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/courses/data-center-ups-battery-safety?buy=857
- [Batteries and DC Circuits](https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/courses/batteries-dc-circuits): $99.99 per seat, 2 Hours. Master DC circuit fundamentals and battery behavior behind every backup power system. Enroll: https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/courses/batteries-dc-circuits?buy=1084
- [RCRA Universal Waste Handler Training](https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training): $34.99 per seat, 2 Hours, 40 CFR 273 (RCRA). Managing spent and damaged batteries. Enroll: https://lithium-ion.hazwoperosha.us/courses/rcra-universal-waste-handler-training?buy=602
